Helping overseas-backed technology start-ups build teams in India

Visibility and set-up support for a series of chip-design businesses scaling up in India.

The objective

From the mid-2000s, a series of venture-funded fabless semiconductor start-ups, designing chips for wireless and broadcast communications, set up in India. Each needed to attract experienced engineers quickly, which called for high visibility.

Shyam’s contribution

As chief executive of a public relations firm, Shyam worked with the leadership of three such companies, in a series of separate assignments.

He shaped their messages and positioning, and arranged media interviews with their prominent investors explaining what each company was doing and how its work could transform communications and networking systems.

From the companies’ first days, he also helped coordinate their set-up in India and the support they needed to operate.

The outcome

According to Shyam, each company grew to about 100 employees within six months. That growth reflected each company’s wider efforts; Shyam’s work supported its visibility, recruitment and set-up.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani’s account.

The experience this brings

Building visibility that helps new technology businesses attract talent, and coordinating the practical steps of setting up in India.

Related services

  • Establish cross-border operations
